deliveryComponents: The EuroHPC Joint Undertaking has signed a supply contract with E4 MeluXina-AI, which forms part of the Luxembourg AI Factory initiative and will be hosted and managed by LuxProvide . The new system will strengthen Europe’s capabilities in artificial intelligence, machine learning and data science, providing the computing power r equired for the training, testing and pre-production deployment of advanced AI models, and supporting research, innovation and industrial development in strategic sectors such as finance, space, cybersecurity and the green economy . The system will be complemented by a rich and scalable software ecosystem, designed to meet the needs of start-ups, companies of all sizes, researchers and industry. The project will be co-funded with a total budget of 80 million euros, 50 per cent of which will be covered by the EuroHPC JU through the Digital Europe Programme (DEP). puter Engineering, a company selected as the contractor following a call for tenders launched in February 2026, for the procurement, delivery, installation and maintenance of MeluXina-AI, the new AI-optimised supercomputer intended for the Luxembourg AI Factory.

supplyFacts.source_quote: San Jose, California, July 14, 2026 – Today, TYLsemi™ emerged from stealth and announced the closing of an oversubscribed $43 million early-stage funding round to accelerate the development of AI infrastructure. TYLsemi is the first chiplet platform company to deliver a full portfolio across IO, power delivery, and memory paired with a chiplet-based custom silicon design, integration and supply-chain ownership. This standards-based, production-ready portfolio will provide AI infrastructure customers with a faster, lower-risk path for developing AI silicon from architecture to deployment.
